items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Well, I heard them in Chicago.

ctx.x: Say? Did you hear them here or up in Chicago?

Well, I heard them in Chicago. Quite a bit, but... I mean, I'm paying. I had forgotten it, at least let it alone. Some of them I like, you know, lots of music. I think they got pretty good swing music. Pretty good. Coming into jazz at that particular time, I was very keen, as I thought, within myself. Just practically, I know of it. It was a lot of quality to me. I... Some of them I hadn't heard the swing that they had, you know. They were changing just fast. And then it just... Things just went then, you know.…
Did you ever go to the Dreamland or the Royal Gardens in Chicago or the Deakin Theatre or any of those places like that?
